findings.description: The limitation of liability is excessively one-sided and excludes consequential damages without justification.

findings.title: Governing Law Ambiguity
findings.description: The governing law clause does not clearly specify the applicable jurisdiction.

findings.title: Missing Force Majeure Clause
findings.description: The contract does not include a force majeure clause as required by law.

findings.title: Warranties and Representations Insufficient
findings.description: The warranties and representations do not cover all necessary aspects.

findings.title: Intellectual Property Rights Not Adequately Addressed
findings.description: The IP clause does not specify ownership of newly created IP or licensing terms.

findings.title: Employment Terms Not Documented
findings.description: The employment terms for augmented staff are not documented as required by law.

findings.title: Probation Period Terms Missing
findings.description: The contract does not specify probation period terms for augmented staff.

findings.title: Excessive Working Hours
findings.description: The document specifies working hours of 60 hours per week, exceeding the maximum limit.

findings.title: Lack of Overtime Compensation
findings.description: The document states no overtime compensation shall be payable, which violates the requirement for overtime pay.

findings.title: Insufficient Annual Leave
findings.description: The document provides only twelve days of annual leave, which is below the required thirty days after one year of service.

findings.title: Missing Sick Leave Provisions
findings.description: The document does not mention sick leave entitlements as required.

findings.title: No End-of-Service Gratuity
findings.description: The document states no end-of-service gratuity shall be payable to augmented staff, which violates the gratuity requirement.

findings.title: Insufficient Notice Period
findings.description: The notice period for termination is stated as seven days, which is below the required thirty days.

findings.title: Missing Wage Payment Requirements
findings.description: The document does not specify wage payment requirements or compliance with the Wage Protection System.
